name: Naneval
body:
In a reality at the edge of the Stattered Worlds exists a species of canid humanoids whose star-faring neighbors sought to control or eradicate at different points in their history. The naneval were a peaceful (by relative standards) people before they were thrust into the galactic forefront and made to adapt or perish; so adapt, they did. Some did so by learning to control and replicate the technology forced upon them. Others closed themselves off to their brethren and taught themselves how to fight against those advancements through natural and magical means. In the scant few files kept on the naneval in the Collective’s databanks, it’s suggested that there are other, lesser known members of that ancestry, but no further details have come to light yet.

Physical Description: Naneval are wolf-like humanoids with greenish gray skin and patches of fur that grow in patterns on their bodies. Swirls of color act as birthmarks that differentiate one naneval from another, and some accentuate these natural highlights with neon pigments, ritual tattoos, or sometimes both.

Gender	Base Height	Base Weight	Weight Modifier	Modifier
Male	5 ft. 10 in.	259 lbs.	2d8	x3
Female	4 ft. 7 in.	183 lbs.	2d8	x3
Adult	Middle Age	Old	Venerable	Maximum Age
17	33	49	65	+2d8 years

Society: Before their world was invaded, the naneval lived simple lives as hunter-gatherers. They tamed the beasts of their homelands, worshiped their world as their great creator deity, and organized their people into close knit families who protected their young and infirm from others who would take over and change their ways.

When the outworlders initially landed, there was a brief and overwhelming conflict that saw the capture or death of several entire families who fought back against them. The rest either abandoned their ancestral homes to hide in the wilderness and become more feral, or combined their efforts to turn back the invaders, only to be subsumed much like those before them.

Those who eventually returned home began transforming it to meet modern requirements taught to them in the generations they were away. They have persisted, fighting back their wilder cousins who continue to push back against such advancements and reincorporate any who wish to return to their natural ways.

Relations: Naneval get along well with those who respect their history, their ways, and their views. They are fiercely protective of tradition, seeing it as the last remaining vestige of their past, and have translated that practice to also mean guarding those who they see as siding with them.

Alignment & Religion: Though some see it as rustic and barbaric, naneval culture is as diverse as any, and alignment varies from one to the other. As a society, more primitive naneval could be seen as true neutral, whereas those who live now lean more toward lawful neutral after being incorporated into the larger galaxy. As for religion, naneval who grew up in their families find comfort in the spiritual worship of the natural world. Otherwise, they are free to worship any deity that suits their needs.

Adventurers: Adventuring is a rite of passage for naneval who wish to be recognized by their people, and something that has remained even with those who were taken away. To quest is to prove the worth of one’s life, and indeed some who left saw it as exactly that; a test they must overcome to honor their families.

Names: Traditional naneval names can give a lot of information about an individual and their family. Names ending in ‘az’ or ‘oz,’ for example, tend to be given to children held in high honor or expectation, and names with three or more syllables are reserved for those born later in a family’s lineage because they take on aspects of their forebears.

Example Traditional Names: Draz, Ordraz, Harvet, Luroz-har, Vonratar

Example Incorporated Names: Bey, Donoda(n), Rex, Sira, Wolf

Ancestry Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom. Naneval are naturally strong, alert, and aware of the world around them.
Size: Medium. As Medium creatures, naneval have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Normal. A naneval’s base speed is 30 feet.
Rougaru: Nanevals are humanoids with the rougaru subtype.
Keen Smell: Naneval gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Sense Motive checks when they can potentially smell something, such as fear, musk, or sweat.
Naneval Heritage: At character creation, choose a naneval heritage. Once this choice is made, it cannot be changed.
Languages: A naneval begins play speaking Common and Rougaru. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except for secret languages, such as Druidic).
Naneval Heritages

Changes to ability scores are applied in addition to those granted by the base ancestry traits.

Nanevarian

The brutish naneval who secluded themselves when more advanced beings invaded their world and took their kin away are colloquially referred to as nanevarians, though they prefer true naneval. Those who wish to honor their ancestry sometimes pass into shattered worlds through the portals left by others. Mutations passed down from interference in their bloodlines are seen as chosen to bear a greater burden than others, and therefore have been granted the honorific of nanazval.

Ability Score Modifiers: –2. While they are well-versed in the natural world, nanevarians lack the formal education that sets their brethren apart.
Low-Light Vision: A nanevarian can see twice as far as a human in conditions of dim light.
Animalistic: Choose one—the nanevarian gains a primary bite attack that deals 1d4 piercing damage on a hit with a x3 critical multiplier; or it gains two primary claw attacks that each deal 1d3 slashing damage with a critical threat range of 19-20 x2.
Naturalistic: Nanevarians always treat Knowledge (nature) and Survival as class skills, and they gain a +1 racial bonus on Knowledge (nature) checks.
Scent: Nanevarians have developed their keen smell into the scent ability.
Nanoval

Naneval who were modified with technological implants and given formal education by their captors have taken to calling themselves nanoval, which in their native dialect puts greater emphasis on the middle syllable. Nanoval who were further mutated are sometimes referred to by their smaller kin as nanoval instead.

Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, –4 Wisdom. Nanoval are more adroit than their wilder cousins, but the connection to their natural roots has suffered greatly as a result of technological advancements.
Senses: Darkvision. Nanoval can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
Formal Training: Choose one Craft, Knowledge, Performance, or Profession skill. That skill is always a class skill for the nanoval, and it gains a +2 racial bonus on checks with that skill.
Outlander: You gain the exile, lore keeper, or missionary benefit (your choice) of the outlander campaign trait.
Tech-Savvy: Choose one—the nanoval is proficient with all firearms; or it gains Exotic Weapon Proficiency with a technological weapon of its choice. Once this choice is made, it cannot be changed.
Naneval Mutants (Advanced)

Naneval mutants have all of the base ancestry traits and heritage of standard naneval, but they have been genetically modified to be tougher, more threatening warriors.

These traits are in addition to those granted by the naneval’s ancestry and heritage.

Ability Score Modifiers: Naneval mutants are naturally tough and imposing, and their size makes them stronger, but less agile. They gain +2 Strength, –2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +4 Charisma
Size: Large. As Large creatures As Large creatures, naneval mutants take a –1 size penalty to their AC, a –1 size penalty on attack rolls, and a –4 size penalty on Stealth checks They gain a +1 bonus on combat maneuver checks and to their CMD. Naneval mutants take up a space that is 10 feet by 10 feet and have a reach of 5 feet.
Speed: Slow. A naneval mutant’s base speed is 20 feet, but its speed is never modified by armor or encumbrance.
Type: Monstrous Humanoid. A naneval mutant counts as both a monstrous humanoid and a humanoid with the rougaru subtype for the purpose of effects that can target either.
Favored Class Bonuses

When you gain your first favored class bonus, choose one class to which all of the below options apply.

Any: Add +1/2 on critical hit confirmation rolls for attacks made with unarmed strikes or natural weapons (maximum bonus of +5). This stacks with Critical Focus, but only to a +5 total bonus.
Any: Add +1/2 on initiative rolls when the naneval isn’t surprised (maximum bonus of +5). This stacks with Improved Initiative, but only to a +5 total bonus.
Fighter: Choose the grapple or trip combat maneuver. Add +1/3 to the Fighter’s CMB when attempting this maneuver (maximum bonus of +4).
Druid: Add +1/3 to the druid’s natural armor bonus when using wild shape.
Gunslinger: Add +1/4 to the dodge bonus to AC granted by the nimble class feature (maximum +2) or +1/4 to the AC bonus gained when using the gunslinger’s dodge deed.
Keyblade: Gain 1/6 of a new keybind power.
Knight of the Jade Eye: Add +1 to the knight’s base speed. In combat this option has no effect unless the knight of the Jade Eye has selected it five times (or another increment of five). This bonus stacks with the monk’s fast movement class feature and applies under the same conditions as that feature.
Nanocyte: Gain 1/6 of the Agile Host nanocyte talent.
Vanguard: You can use aspect embodiment 1/3 additional times per minute, but only once per round.
